brand_context.name: PlaceContext
brand_context.offering: Agentic workflow platform for critical workflows

candidate.central_idea: One continuous path doubles back around an open central space.
candidate.visual_mechanism: A single uniform line starts at upper left, travels right, turns downward through two rounded right-angle bends and returns left at the lower level, then folds inward to end at the center-right; a deliberate short gap in the right boundary keeps the central negative space open.
candidate.distinctive_element: An asymmetrical squared spiral with exactly two generous turns and one open gate.
candidate.shape_logic: precise open geometry, ample negative space
candidate.composition: single centered mark occupying half the square canvas
